Your mail stays yours.

Email holds the keys to everything else you do online. Typhoonpost is built so that nobody but you can read yours.

How we protect your mail

  • Your mail is yours alone

    Every message is locked to your account at the database level. Other users and other tenants can never read it, even by accident.

  • Hostile HTML gets stripped

    Incoming messages are sanitised before they are displayed, so scripts, tracking tricks and unsafe links do not get a chance to run.

  • Authenticated sending

    Mail goes out through verified SPF and DKIM on your own domain, which keeps your messages out of junk folders.

  • We sell mailboxes, not attention

    There is no ad profile built from your messages. Typhoonpost is paid for by the people who use it.

  • Custom domains for your team

    Bring your own domain and give everyone a professional address that you control.

  • Open about how it works

    Plain-language policies and a public roadmap, so you always know what is happening with your data.

Questions, answered.

What is Typhoonpost?

Typhoonpost is a modern email, calendar and contacts workspace. It is built for people who want the polish of the big suites without the clutter or the ads.

Is it ready to use today?

Typhoonpost is in early access. You can create an account, send and receive mail, and use the calendar and contacts while we finish the remaining features.

Can I use my own domain?

Yes. Business plans let you use your own domain, with sending authenticated through SPF and DKIM.

Who can read my email?

Only you. Messages are stored per account with database-level access rules, and nobody else on the platform can open them.

Do you show ads or sell my data?

No. Typhoonpost does not build ad profiles from your messages and does not sell your data.

Can I move over from another provider?

Import tools are on the roadmap. In the meantime you can forward mail from your old address while you switch over.

How much does it cost?

Starter is free during early access. Business and Enterprise plans are billed per user, and you can see the details on the pricing page.
